items.name: access-pass
items.title: Access Pass
items.description: When an agent wants more access it hands you a boarding pass that says who, what and why; pick once, an hour or always, approve, and the stub tears off along the perforation into a little pass with a countdown and Revoke.

items.name: account-card
items.title: Account Card
items.description: The card behind your avatar: who you're signed in as, how far your profile has come and the one step to do next, plus your menu and theme.

items.name: accounts-crm
items.title: Pipeline Today
items.description: A salesperson's morning view: drag deals between stages (or move them with the keyboard) while each column's weighted value and the forecast roll live, and a Focus rail tells you who to act on and why, with one-click email, call and snooze that update the deal.

items.name: admin-users
items.title: Admin Users
items.description: A members admin with seat and 2FA stats, role and status filters, a sortable table you can bulk-edit, an invite dialog that checks emails as chips, and a drawer with each person's devices and activity.

items.name: alert-rules
items.title: Alert Rules
items.description: An alert you write as a sentence: when error rate is above 2% for at least 5 minutes, only for checkout in production, page the on-call. A 30-day timeline shows which past incidents it would have caught, and warns you before it gets noisy.

items.name: appearance-settings
items.title: Appearance Settings
items.description: Theme cards with miniature previews above a compact live app that re-themes with a circular wipe, eases into your accent colour and glides between densities as you change them.

items.name: article-cards
items.title: Article Cards
items.description: A blog grid led by one large featured post, each card with drawn cover art, tags, reading time and author, lifting gently on hover while its cover drifts closer.

items.name: assistant-app
items.title: Assistant App
items.description: A small, complete assistant with chats and projects in the sidebar, files you can attach, and replies that write themselves out word by word.

items.name: assistant-start
items.title: Assistant Start
items.description: The first screen of an AI assistant, with chats and projects down the side, a gooey orb that says hello and a prompt box that gathers tools and connected apps as context, then glides down into the conversation when you send.

items.name: backseat
items.title: Backseat
items.description: Nudge an agent while it works: type a note and it joins the plan as soon as the current step wraps up, or hit Interrupt to stop it right where it is.

items.name: before-after-hero
items.title: Before & After Hero
items.description: A hero split down the middle: drag the handle and a messy expense spreadsheet turns into a clean, matched ledger row by row, while the headline flips from a week to an afternoon.

items.name: bell-quiet
items.title: Bell Quiet
items.description: Empty-state art for notifications: a sleepy bell breathing out little z's – hover and it startles awake with a tiny ring, then dozes off again.

items.name: billing-overview
items.title: Billing Overview
items.description: A billing page in one glance: plan and seats, the next invoice with its cycle progress, a payment card that holds its colours in both themes, usage bars that warn near the limit, and invoices with a one-click retry.

items.name: blur-rise
items.title: Blur Rise
items.description: Text that drifts up and comes into focus a letter or a word at a time as it scrolls into view, quick enough that nobody waits to read it.

items.name: branch-graph
items.title: Branch Graph
items.description: A git log drawn as a graph: each branch gets its own coloured lane, merges sweep in on smooth curves, refs and tags sit on their commits, and hovering a row slides a detail card along with you.

items.name: browser-tabs
items.title: Browser Tabs
items.description: A browser tab strip: drag tabs to reorder, close one and its neighbours slide in under your pointer, pin from the right-click menu, and scroll when the strip overflows.

items.name: calendar-week
items.title: Calendar Week
items.description: A week calendar you can push around: drag events to move or stretch them on a 15-minute snap, drag empty time to create one, nudge with the arrow keys, and watch the now line creep down the day.

items.name: card-deal
items.title: Card Deal
items.description: A grid that deals itself out from one point like a hand of cards: each card flies to its slot tilted and settles flat, and a shuffle sweeps them back into the deck and deals a fresh order, even mid-flight.

items.name: card-pile
items.title: Card Pile
items.description: Notifications stacked like a small deck of cards: flick the top one away, or press Delete, and the next one steps forward.

items.name: card-stack
items.title: Card Stack
items.description: Payment cards tucked in a stitched leather wallet – hover and they rise out in a fan, click the front one to lift it clear and flip it, or a peeking one to pull it forward.

items.name: carrier-bird
items.title: Carrier Bird
items.description: A round little bird hops beside a sealed letter; press send and it hops over, grabs the envelope and flaps off on a dotted trail before a tick confirms it's sent.

items.name: cart-drawer
items.title: Cart Drawer
items.description: A slide-over bag with quantity steppers, line totals and subtotal that roll digit by digit, a free-shipping bar that fills as you add, and a friendly empty state.

items.name: changelog
items.title: Changelog
items.description: A release timeline with sticky version tags, New / Improved / Fixed chips you can filter by, small drawn media cards instead of screenshots, and a load-more that eases older releases into place.

items.name: chat-branches
items.title: Chat Branches
items.description: A conversation you can fork from any message, with a little branch map up top that shows every path you tried and hops between them in one click.

items.name: checkout
items.title: Checkout
items.description: A one-page checkout that folds each finished step into a one-line summary: inline validation that clears as you type, delivery choices that re-total the order, a card that flips when you reach the CVC, and a calm confirmation.

items.name: checkout-summary
items.title: Checkout Summary
items.description: A checkout with generic express-pay buttons, delivery options that slide a selection ring, quantity steppers, a promo field that validates, and totals whose digits roll as anything changes.

items.name: city-time
items.title: City Time
items.description: A local-time page for any city: a live clock whose digits roll, the sun on today's arc, your working hours against theirs with the best time to meet, and the year's clock changes, all re-computed as you switch cities.

items.name: co-writing-doc
items.title: Co-writing Doc
items.description: A document where AI agents write alongside you: coloured cursors with name tags glide between words, an agent types its suggestion letter by letter for you to accept or reject, and comments sit in the margin next to the lines they're about.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A code viewer with file tabs, hand-rolled syntax colour, click-to-highlight lines, a diff view that works out the +/− itself, wrap and copy, and long files that fold behind a fade.

items.name: code-entry
items.title: Code Entry
items.description: A six-digit code field with a ring that glides from slot to slot, room to paste the whole code, a small shake when it's wrong and slots that flow together into a “Verified” pill when it's right.

items.name: code-review
items.title: Code Review
items.description: A pull request review with a file tree, split or unified diffs with word-level highlights, inline threads you can reply to and resolve, Viewed checkboxes that fold files away, and an approve or request-changes panel.

items.name: cohort-grid
items.title: Cohort Grid
items.description: A retention triangle by signup week: hover or arrow through any cell to light its row and column, read it against the average, and flip between percentages and head counts.

items.name: colour-field
items.title: Colour Field
items.description: An OKLCH colour picker that shows you the real shape of sRGB for each hue, tells you how the colour reads on white and black, and copies it as OKLCH or hex.

items.name: conductor
items.title: Conductor
items.description: Chat with a lead agent while it works: it streams its replies, hands tasks to helpers whose progress ticks along in a side panel and writes what it learns straight into a launch brief you can edit beside the chat.

items.name: confetti-burst
items.title: Confetti Burst
items.description: Confetti that blooms out of the button you pressed, hangs at the top of its arc in the air drag, flutters as each piece turns over and drifts down; reduced motion gets a quick check instead.

items.name: connection-card
items.title: Connection Card
items.description: Everything one connected service needs on a single card, its key, its site and its time zone, with a save bar that only turns up once you've changed something.

items.name: connection-lost
items.title: Connection Lost
items.description: An offline banner for apps: it counts the changes kept on the device, rolls a retry countdown with backoff, shows liquid dots while reconnecting, then turns into Back online with a drawn check and slides away.

items.name: connector-marketplace
items.title: Connector Marketplace
items.description: A place to browse the apps that plug into your product: filter by category, search, and connect one through a short permissions step that shows the link being made.

items.name: connector-search
items.title: Connector Search
items.description: Type to find a service, step through with the arrow keys, and open one to check how its sync is doing or connect it right there.

items.name: connectors
items.title: Connectors
items.description: Browse every app your product plugs into, grouped by category in tidy two-up cards, with a sticky search, filters that glide, connect buttons that spin and settle into a quiet connected state, and a slide-over for permissions and settings.

items.name: constellation
items.title: Constellation
items.description: Your agents and the tools they reach for, drawn as a small constellation: each call and its answer travel the line as a spark, busy lines glow brighter, and an agent that needs you turns amber with Approve right underneath.

items.name: conveyor
items.title: Conveyor
items.description: A job queue on a little conveyor belt: jobs drop on, ride into whichever worker frees up and land in Done or Failed, and when a rate limit hits the belt stops while the backlog chart shows the pile-up and the drain.

items.name: coupon-field
items.title: Coupon Field
items.description: A promo code field that checks your code, then either folds it into a tag while the savings line slides in and the total rolls down, or shakes once and says exactly why it failed.

items.name: credit-gauge
items.title: Credit Gauge
items.description: See where this month's credits went: a split bar by category with a warning line and a hard limit, daily spend against budget, and a plan button that gets more insistent as you close in on the cap.

items.name: cron-builder
items.title: Cron Builder
items.description: Edit a cron expression field by field or with friendly controls, read it back as a plain sentence, see the next five runs in your timezone update as you type, and get told exactly why a schedule is invalid or can never run.

items.name: dashboard-header
items.title: Dashboard Header
items.description: The top of a dashboard: three trend cards, a this-period-versus-last chart you can scrub day by day, and a goal ring that fills as sales come in.

items.name: delivery-tracker
items.title: Delivery Tracker
items.description: Live order tracking on a hand-drawn city map: the courier rides the route as the ETA counts down, you can zoom in to follow them, message with quick replies, and rate and tip once it lands.

items.name: departures
items.title: Departures
items.description: An airport departures board for your agents: each row flips letter by letter as work boards, runs, gets delayed or lands, hand-offs show as connecting flights, and the one waiting on you glows amber with an Approve button.

items.name: deploy-pipeline
items.title: Deploy Pipeline
items.description: Install, build, test and deploy as stages that light up and connect as they pass, live timers, a log peek that follows the running stage, a failed stage you can retry in place, and the preview URL as a chip when it’s ready.

items.name: desk-bot
items.title: Desk Bot
items.description: A little desk robot that follows your cursor with glowing eyes, perks its antenna when you come close, and nods off after a few quiet seconds until you tap it awake.

items.name: developer-settings
items.title: API Keys & Webhooks
items.description: Scoped API keys with a show-once secret, roll and revoke, plus webhook endpoints with event picking, a signing secret and a deliveries log where failed sends retry and flip to 200.

items.name: docs-layout
items.title: Docs Layout
items.description: A docs page shell: grouped sidebar, readable article with tabbed code and callouts, a reading-progress hairline and a right-hand outline whose marker glides to the section you're reading; the sidebar becomes a drawer on phones.

items.name: docs-site
items.title: Docs Site
items.description: A documentation site with a top nav, collapsible sidebar, code samples whose language choice follows you across the page, a table of contents that tracks your scroll, ⌘K search over pages and headings, and prev and next cards.

items.name: donut-legend
items.title: Donut Legend
items.description: A donut and its legend wired both ways: point at a slice or a row and the slice swells, the rest step back and the centre figure rolls to it; click a row to take it out of the total.

items.name: dot-map
items.title: Dot Map
items.description: A dotted world map drawn from a hand-made land mask, with one region lit up, live sessions pulsing across it and a switcher that moves the spotlight.

items.name: draft-review
items.title: Draft Review
items.description: An email the assistant wrote for you to check before it goes: change who it's to or how it sounds, tweak the words, and send with a few seconds to take it back.

items.name: drift-chart
items.title: Drift Chart
items.description: An agent's plan drawn as dashed outlines with the real work filling in over them: when a step runs long it spills into amber, nudges everything after it to the right and drags the finish line with it.

items.name: drip-badge
items.title: Drip Badge
items.description: A notification count made of liquid: a new one makes a droplet drip off the bottom, reading one pinches a piece off the side, and the number rolls either way.

items.name: drip-loaders
items.title: Drip Loaders
items.description: Three loaders made of liquid in whatever colour you like: a comet of drops that stretches and gathers, a bead that drips into a pool, and a dot that splits and flows back together.

items.name: drip-tabs
items.title: Drip Tabs
items.description: Vertical settings tabs where the highlight runs down the rail like a bead of water, trailing a little drop that catches up and sinks back in.

items.name: drive
items.title: Drive
items.description: A cloud drive home with a sidebar of places and quick access, start-from-template cards, and folders that glide between a card grid and a tidy table when you switch views, with search, sort and stars.

items.name: droplet-button
items.title: Droplet Button
items.description: A pill button that squashes when you press it and, as you let go, flicks a little crown of droplets from right where you pressed, then swallows them back up.

items.name: droplet-ring
items.title: Droplet Ring
items.description: Your mark on a liquid disc that buds app tiles out like droplets, springs them into a ring, lets them bob for a moment, then pulls them back in and starts again.

items.name: elastic-list
items.title: Elastic List
items.description: A scrolling list with real rubber-band edges: drag or flick past either end and it stretches with growing resistance, then springs back, pulling down from the top winds up a spinner that snaps when it's ready to refresh, and the wheel hands off to the page once you reach an end.

items.name: empty-bag
items.title: Empty Bag
items.description: Empty-cart art: a shopping bag slumps and sighs, perks up when a price tag dangles in, and puffs up proudly with a bounce when you add something.

items.name: env-editor
items.title: Env Editor
items.description: Environment variables as a table with a column per environment: secrets masked until you reveal them, click-to-edit cells, paste a whole .env to bulk import, and every unsaved edit tinted until you save or discard.

items.name: envelope
items.title: Envelope
items.description: A kraft envelope that pops its wax seal, swings the flap open and lets a letter spring up – then tucks it back in and reseals itself.

items.name: facets
items.title: Facets
items.description: Filters tucked into collapsible checkbox groups and echoed above as chips you can pop off one by one, with search, Clear all and full arrow-key control.

items.name: faq
items.title: FAQ
items.description: A searchable FAQ with topic tabs and live counts, matches marked in place, answers that open on a smooth measured height, and a copy-link button on every question that deep-links straight to it.

items.name: feature-bento
items.title: Feature Bento
items.description: A bento grid of feature tiles, each with a tiny working demo (search, shortcuts, version history, a flow, a chart) that wakes up on hover and rests when you leave.

items.name: file-tree
items.title: File Tree
items.description: A project tree that feels like your editor: arrow keys to open folders, git changes marked in colour, F2 to rename and drag to tidy things up.

items.name: fill-in-prompts
items.title: Fill-in Prompts
items.description: Saved prompts you fill in right inside the sentence, each blank growing with its text in its own colour, with quick picks for common answers and a Use button that waits until every gap is filled.

items.name: filter-bar
items.title: Filter Bar
items.description: Linear-style filter chips you build from one menu: Status is not Done, Labels include Bug, Assignee is me. Click any part of a chip to change it, press F to add one, Backspace to drop it, and the issue list re-sorts itself as you go.

items.name: first-project
items.title: First Project
items.description: The empty Projects page of an app: one line on what projects are for, a Create button with its shortcut, a guide link and three templates. Creating one flies the icon into the first row of a real project list.

items.name: first-run
items.title: First Run
items.description: A four-step setup for a brand-new AI workspace, with a springy stepper, tools that connect right where they sit, invites as chips, a live preview of your first agent and a calm summary you can jump back from.

items.name: flag-board
items.title: Flag Board
items.description: Feature flags per environment: flip a flag, drag its rollout and see how many people that is, target segments with chips, and a kill switch you have to press and hold, with undo, before it turns everything off.

items.name: flag-playground
items.title: Flag Playground
items.description: Paste a user as JSON and watch every flag decide, rule by rule: each condition ticks or crosses, the winning rule lights up, later ones grey out, and the served variant swaps in. Broken JSON and wrong types get called out instead of quietly failing.

items.name: flag-targeting
items.title: Flag Targeting
items.description: Targeting rules for a feature flag, per environment: if beta and in Europe serve the new checkout, roll out to 10% of everyone else, fall back when it's off, and see who gets what across 2,000 simulated users while you edit.

items.name: flags-console
items.title: Flags Console
items.description: A whole flag console in one piece: search and filter your flags, pick one to edit its targeting rules and rollout per environment, and watch a live log of requests getting their variant, with a marker the moment your change takes effect.

items.name: flame-profile
items.title: Flame Profile
items.description: An agent run as a flame graph, one stacked frame per call and as wide as it took; switch the lens to tokens or cost and the frames spring to their new sizes, click any frame to zoom in, and the slowest one is flagged for you.

items.name: flip-clock
items.title: Flip Clock
items.description: A split-flap countdown where each changed digit's top flap falls away under gravity, darkening as it turns, and the new lower flap lands with one small rebound.

items.name: folder-view
items.title: Folder View
items.description: One folder opened inside a drive, with a folder tree in the sidebar, type filters with counts, a grid of file cards with little drawn previews or a dense table, a bulk bar that rises with a rolling count when you pick a few, and ghost files fanning out of an empty sub-folder.

items.name: footnoted-answer
items.title: Footnoted Answer
items.description: An answer whose footnotes really point somewhere: hover a number and its sentence lights up in the source's colour, click it and the quoted passage unfolds with the matching words marked.

items.name: forgot-password
items.title: Forgot Password
items.description: Ask for a reset link, then a confirmation with the address it went to, a resend countdown and a way back to sign in.

items.name: funnel
items.title: Funnel
items.description: A conversion funnel where each bar keeps a hatched ghost of what the step before had, so drop-off reads at a glance; flip between counts and percentages and hover a step for its channel split.

items.name: ghostwriters
items.title: Ghostwriters
items.description: A shared draft with a few ghostwriters in it: each agent's cursor glides in with its name, picks a phrase and types its suggestion right there in the text, and you keep or toss each one, or let them settle on their own.

items.name: gift-box
items.title: Gift Box
items.description: A referral reward that wobbles with anticipation: the bow unties, the lid pops off and lands beside it, and a credit coupon rises out in a warm glow with a few sparkles.

items.name: go-no-go
items.title: Go / No-go
items.description: A clear yes or no for risky agent actions that shows the exact command or diff, answers to Y and N, and folds into a one-line receipt you can undo.

items.name: growth-chart
items.title: Growth Chart
items.description: A record-month moment: a little ball hops up a staircase of bars, each one springing up under it as the total ticks over, and plants a flag on the peak.

items.name: habits
items.title: Habits
items.description: A habit tracker that makes ticking things off feel good: checks fill and draw in a beat, counted habits fill like a glass, streaks roll up, and a week grid lets you patch the days you forgot to log.

items.name: hairline-shell
items.title: Hairline Shell
items.description: An app frame drawn edge to edge on single hairlines, with header and footer rules running straight across, a marker that slides along the edge to the current page and a dense issue list you can walk with J and K.

items.name: handoff-card
items.title: Handoff Card
items.description: Pass work to a teammate with the summary, open questions and links in one card; when they accept, it flips over to show who owns it now.

items.name: help-centre
items.title: Help Centre
items.description: A support site with a search that suggests articles as you type, topic cards, readable articles with a table of contents that follows you, and a feedback form that asks what went wrong.

items.name: highlighter
items.title: Highlighter
items.description: A marker pen that sweeps behind your words one line after another, with a chisel tip, slightly ragged edges and ink that pools where each stroke starts and stops; runs when it scrolls into view or when its row is hovered.

items.name: inbox-preview
items.title: Inbox Preview
items.description: A mail client in one block: unread dots, coloured labels, hover actions, rows you swipe to archive or mark read (with undo), j/k/e shortcuts and a reading pane that slides over the list on phones.

items.name: inbox-zero
items.title: Inbox Zero
items.description: A tidy desk for the moment the inbox empties: the last email folds into a paper plane, loops out through the window, the counter rolls to zero and the dusk sky turns to day.

items.name: incident-banner
items.title: Incident Banner
items.description: A dismissible status banner that moves through investigating, identified, monitoring and resolved: its colour, icon and progress track change with each update, and the timeline unfolds underneath.

items.name: ink-stamp
items.title: Ink Stamp
items.description: A rubber stamp that rises, winds up and slams onto the page with a quick squash and a jolt through the card, lifting away to leave a rough, slightly bled ink impression that comes out a little different every time.

items.name: inset-shell
items.title: Inset Shell
items.description: The frame an app lives in: a sidebar with workspace switcher, nav, colour-dotted projects and an account menu that folds down to an icon rail, beside a rounded inset page with live breadcrumbs and a floating drawer on phones.

items.name: intake-survey
items.title: Intake Survey
items.description: A one-question-at-a-time onboarding survey: answer with A–D, a quick blink confirms your pick before the next question glides in, multi-select with a limit, an optional free-text step and an editable summary at the end.

items.name: invite-teammates
items.title: Invite Teammates
items.description: Paste a whole list of emails and they sort themselves into chips, each with its own role, with typos caught before anyone gets a broken invite.

items.name: issue-tracker
items.title: Issue Tracker
items.description: An issue list you drive with your hands on the keys: J and K to move, S, P, A and L to change status, priority, assignee and labels, X to multi-select, ⌘K for everything else, and rows glide to their new group when they change.

items.name: json-explorer
items.title: JSON Explorer
items.description: A JSON tree you can actually read: types in colour, key and item counts, inline previews of folded branches, copy-any-path, and a search that opens the tree down to every match and steps through them.

items.name: kanban-board
items.title: Kanban Board
items.description: A team board you can really work in: drag cards between columns, add one with a keystroke, filter by label, and open any card for its checklist and notes.

items.name: keyboard-cat
items.title: Keyboard Cat
items.description: Loading art with a cat loafing on a laptop: its paws knead the keys so they light up while code types out and the progress bar fills, then it stretches and hops off when the job is done.

items.name: latency-histogram
items.title: Latency Histogram
items.description: Request latency as a histogram with p50, p95 and p99 marked on it; drag a brush across the bars (or Shift-arrow) to see how many requests fall in any window.

items.name: launch-list
items.title: Launch List
items.description: A getting-started list in tidy groups with a ring that fills as you go, where each task ticks and strikes through once it's done.

items.name: launch-pad
items.title: Launch Pad
items.description: A little rocket venting steam on its pad – click and it lights up, lifts off on a trail of smoke, then drops back in on a retro burn and lands.

items.name: launcher
items.title: Launcher
items.description: A search button that grows into a keyboard launcher, with grouped actions and their shortcuts, your recent picks, a highlight that glides as you arrow through and pages you can step into.

items.name: lava-lamp
items.title: Lava Lamp
items.description: Warm wax blobs that wander, melt into one another and drift apart behind your content, with one that lazily trails your cursor.

items.name: leaderboard
items.title: Leaderboard
items.description: A ranked list that reshuffles itself when scores land: rows glide to their new places, gains flash beside the rolling totals, and your own row stays pinned below with the gap to the next person.

items.name: lift-to-open
items.title: Lift to Open
items.description: A thumbnail that lifts off the grid and grows into its own detail view as one object, cover and title travelling with it, the details fading in once it lands; Escape or a click outside folds it back into its exact slot.

items.name: like-burst
items.title: Like Burst
items.description: A heart that squeezes and pops full with a thin ring and a flick of sparks, while the count rolls over digit by digit like an odometer; unliking fades back quietly.

items.name: limit-reached
items.title: Limit Reached
items.description: An in-app quota state for when a team runs out of AI runs: a full meter, a countdown to the reset with rolling digits, what still works and what's paused, and an upgrade that rescales the meter in place.

items.name: liquid-checkbox
items.title: Liquid Checkbox
items.description: A checkbox that fills with a little pour of liquid before the tick draws in, and drains when you uncheck it. A select-all box can sit part full as a list gets done.

items.name: liquid-cursor
items.title: Liquid Cursor
items.description: Inside its card the pointer becomes a drop of liquid with a short trail; hover a link or button and the drop pours itself into that shape, then pinches free when you move on.

items.name: liquid-fab
items.title: Liquid FAB
items.description: A round action button that squeezes out its actions as droplets: each one stretches away, pinches off into its own button and gets drawn back in when you close it, with labels as tooltips and full keyboard support.

items.name: liquid-progress
items.title: Liquid Progress
items.description: A progress bar filled with liquid: each jump surges forward and the rounded front wobbles before it settles, and when there's no telling how long it'll take, a slug of it sloshes end to end.

items.name: liquid-segments
items.title: Liquid Segments
items.description: A row of options where the selected pill is a soft blob that stretches, splits and joins back up as it slides, and you can drag it straight to the one you want.

items.name: liquid-slider
items.title: Liquid Slider
items.description: A range slider whose thumb is a droplet: it stretches when you drag fast, melts into the filled track, and buds off a little value bubble while you hold it.

items.name: liquid-switch
items.title: Liquid Switch
items.description: A toggle whose thumb stretches as it crosses, trails two droplets behind it and swallows them back up the moment it lands.

items.name: live-poll
items.title: Live Poll
items.description: Write a poll right in the thread, then watch it fill: bars spring to their share as votes land, your pick stays marked, and closing it locks in the winner.

items.name: log-stream
items.title: Log Stream
items.description: Live logs that stay readable: level filters with counts, search that highlights as it filters, pause and follow with a “new lines” pill, and bursts of the same error folded into one “12 similar” row.

items.name: magnetic
items.title: Magnetic
items.description: Buttons and icons lean toward your pointer as it comes near, labels drifting a little further than their buttons, then spring back the moment you move away.

items.name: magnify-dock
items.title: Magnify Dock
items.description: An app dock that swells under your pointer on a stiff spring, bounces apps as they launch, marks running ones with a dot, and works from the keyboard too.

items.name: mail
items.title: Mail
items.description: A three-pane mail client you can run from the keyboard: J and K walk the threads, E archives with an undo, R drops you into a quick reply, and the reading pane slides over the list on phones.

items.name: margin-notes
items.title: Margin Notes
items.description: A reviewer's pen that draws itself onto your text as it scrolls into view: wobbly circles, double underlines, boxes and strike-throughs, then arrows that curve from a handwritten note to the words it means.

items.name: marquee-text
items.title: Marquee Text
items.description: An oversized headline that scrolls forever in alternating solid and outlined words, gliding to a halt when you hover instead of freezing mid-word.

items.name: mega-footer
items.title: Mega Footer
items.description: A full site footer: link columns with little badges, a one-field digest signup, a live status pill, language and theme switches, a legal row, and an oversized wordmark fading into the floor.

items.name: mention-picker
items.title: Mention Picker
items.description: Type @ in a message and a picker opens right at the caret with people, files and channels; what you pick lands as a token that moves and deletes as one piece.

items.name: metric-card
items.title: Metric Card
items.description: One number with its own hand-drawn chart: switch the range and the lines reshape, scrub with a pointer or the arrow keys for exact figures, and the headline follows wherever you are.

items.name: milestone-rail
items.title: Milestone Rail
items.description: Your onboarding steps on a vertical rail that fills in as each one is done, with a progress bar and percentage keeping count up top.

items.name: mini-sheet
items.title: Mini Sheet
items.description: A pocket spreadsheet on coss ui table styles: drag or shift-select a range, type to edit, copy and paste straight from your sheets app, sort with rows that slide into order, and undo any of it.

items.name: model-switcher
items.title: Model Switcher
items.description: A model menu that helps you choose: hover a model to compare speed, quality and cost, turn on thinking to set the effort, and watch latency and price count to their new values, inline or from a pill trigger.

items.name: money
items.title: Money
items.description: A personal finance home: the balance rolls digit by digit as you switch accounts or pay a bill, the payment lands in your transactions, spending donut and budgets at once, and each budget shows if you’re spending ahead of pace.

items.name: money-input
items.title: Money Input
items.description: An amount field that groups digits as you type without ever losing your caret, follows each currency's own rules (yes, lakh grouping and zero-decimal yen), and keeps the limits in view.

items.name: morph-icons
items.title: Morph Icons
items.description: Menu to close, play to pause, plus to check, sun to moon: each pair is one set of paths in two poses, so lines rotate and stretch into place on a spring and reverse cleanly mid-way.

items.name: music-player
items.title: Music Player
items.description: A music app with gradient cover art that glows into the room, a waveform you can scrub, a drag-to-reorder queue and lyrics that follow the song line by line.

items.name: newsletter-cta
items.title: Newsletter CTA
items.description: An email capture that checks as you go, catches gmial-style typos, shakes once on a bad address, then morphs into a success note while your avatar joins the stack and the reader count rolls up by one.

items.name: night-owl
items.title: Night Owl
items.description: An owl on a branch that follows your cursor and tilts its head at you. Wide awake under the moon in dark mode, heavy-lidded and snoozing in light mode.

items.name: no-results
items.title: No Results
items.description: A search that comes up empty: it repeats the query, suggests the spelling fix, names the filter that is hiding matches and offers popular searches. Removing a filter springs the results back in.

items.name: not-found
items.title: Not Found
items.description: A 404 with a compass that dithers between headings until you move your mouse or start searching, plus a did-you-mean fix for the typo, inline search and popular links.

items.name: notes
items.title: Notes
items.description: A notes app with folders, pinned notes that glide to the top, search that highlights matches as you type, and an editor where typing “[] ”, “- ” or “# ” turns a line into a checklist, bullet or heading.

items.name: notification-centre
items.title: Notification Centre
items.description: A bell whose panel grows out of it: tabs for all, mentions and unread, grouped by day, approve requests inline, archive with undo and a badge that rolls as you read.

items.name: notification-matrix
items.title: Notification Matrix
items.description: Events down the side, email, push and in-app across the top: group checkboxes that go half-checked, locked security rows with a reason, edited cells that glow, and a save bar that floats in only when something changed.

items.name: notification-settings
items.title: Notification Settings
items.description: Channels you can open and tune, per-event email, push and chat toggles grouped under section switches, quiet hours on a small 24-hour track, and a digest line whose item count rolls as you change things.

items.name: nudge
items.title: Nudge
items.description: One clear suggestion with an honest read on how sure it is, a couple of alternatives a tap away, and a short window to undo once you accept.

items.name: odometer
items.title: Odometer
items.description: Digits that turn like a real counter: every place rolls the way the number moved, so 9 ticks over to 0 instead of spinning back, and it counts up the first time you scroll to it.

items.name: order-tracker
items.title: Order Tracker
items.description: A shipment card with a live ETA, a step rail whose current stop gently pulses, carrier scans that slide in as they arrive, and a small spray of confetti when it lands.

items.name: overflow-breadcrumb
items.title: Overflow Breadcrumb
items.description: Breadcrumbs that fold their middle crumbs into a menu as space runs out and unfold as it returns, with a last crumb you can rename in place.

items.name: password-strength
items.title: Password Strength
items.description: A password field that explains itself: it spots common words, years and keyboard runs, says how long a crack would take, and ticks off what's left in plain words.

items.name: payment-failed
items.title: Payment Failed
items.description: A billing state for a declined renewal that names the card and the reason, counts down the grace period, and puts the fixes right there: retry, switch to a saved card or add a new one.

items.name: people-picker
items.title: People Picker
items.description: Find people and teams in one grouped list, see what you typed highlighted in each match, add as many as you like as springy avatar chips, or create someone new right there.

items.name: phase-builder
items.title: Phase Builder
items.description: Lay out one stretch of a contract with its products, cadence, discount and minimum, and watch each month's invoice settle into place as you go.

items.name: phone-field
items.title: Phone Field
items.description: A phone number field with a searchable country picker: it formats the number the local way as you type, drops the habitual leading zero, and spots the country when you paste a +44.

items.name: plan-review
items.title: Plan Review
items.description: Look over an agent's plan before it starts, rename, reorder or drop steps, then follow each one on its own timer and pick up again from the step that broke.

items.name: plant-progress
items.title: Plant Progress
items.description: A seedling that grows with your progress value – the stem climbs, a leaf unfurls at each step, and at 100% it flowers.

items.name: pour-hero
items.title: Pour Hero
items.description: A hero whose headline drips in as lime liquid: drops pinch off the top edge, splash on landing and set into real, selectable type, with a droplet button that squashes and splashes when pressed.

items.name: pour-progress
items.title: Pour Progress
items.description: Progress you can watch fill up: a stream pours in from the top, the surface sloshes and settles as the level eases to the value, and hitting 100% sends out a small ripple. Comes as a round vessel or a slim bar.

items.name: presence-bar
items.title: Presence Bar
items.description: A live facepile for shared docs: status rings, a rolling “viewing” count, faces that spring in and out, and a click to follow someone around the page.

items.name: press-ripple
items.title: Press Ripple
items.description: A quiet wave that spreads from exactly where you pressed, clipped to the element's corners, finishes filling even on a quick tap, and gives Enter and Space the same feedback from the centre.

items.name: pricing-table
items.title: Pricing Table
items.description: Three plans side by side with a monthly or yearly toggle that rolls each price into place, and a full feature table that folds out underneath.

items.name: profile
items.title: Profile
items.description: A social profile with a painted cover, a Follow button that pinches off a notification bell like a droplet, followers that roll up, and posts, replies and a media grid that opens into a lightbox.

items.name: profile-settings
items.title: Profile Settings
items.description: Edit your profile: crop a generated photo in a small dialog, claim a username with a live availability check and suggestions, see your local time on a tiny clock, and save from a bar that springs up when something changes.

items.name: project-pulse
items.title: Project Pulse
items.description: A project in two lines that opens into its tasks: the ring gives every task its own arc in its owner's colour, tap a face to see just their work, and the status chip opens a picker.

items.name: prompt-bar
items.title: Prompt Bar
items.description: A prompt box that grows as you type, with attachments, a model menu, an approval toggle and a mic that opens into a live level meter, plus a send button that only lights up when there's something to send.

items.name: prompt-test-bench
items.title: Prompt Test Bench
items.description: Check a prompt before it ships, with pass rate by version against the bar it has to clear, a unified or side-by-side diff of what changed, and test cases that re-run live from queued to a rolling score.

items.name: quota-ring
items.title: Quota Ring
items.description: A small usage ring that turns amber, then red, as it crosses its thresholds, with a tooltip that breaks the number down and counts down to the reset.

items.name: quote-reply
items.title: Quote Reply
items.description: Highlight any part of a message to get a small Quote action; the snippet rides along in the composer until you send or dismiss it, and tapping it later jumps back to the source.

items.name: quote-wall
items.title: Quote Wall
items.description: Customer quotes stacked in columns that drift past in opposite directions and settle the moment you stop to read one.

items.name: radial-gauge
items.title: Radial Gauge
items.description: A dial with threshold bands and a target notch: the needle springs to each new reading, the fill takes the colour of the band it lands in, and hovering a band names its range.

items.name: range-calendar
items.title: Range Calendar
items.description: Pick a range from two months side by side or a one-click preset, watch it preview as you hover, and line it up against the period before with a single tap.

items.name: reaction-picker
items.title: Reaction Picker
items.description: Tap or hold the smiley and a tray of emoji pours out of it like liquid; slide to one and let go, and it lands on the message as a counted chip with yours lit up.

items.name: read-receipts
items.title: Read Receipts
items.description: Tiny faces that glide down a conversation as people catch up, stacking under the last message they saw and folding into +N when it gets crowded.

items.name: recall
items.title: Recall
items.description: Everything the assistant remembers about you, sorted into groups you can filter, with each memory yours to edit, pause or forget, and an undo if you slip.

items.name: redline
items.title: Redline
items.description: Suggested edits marked up right inside your sentence, so you can keep or drop each one with a click or a key, and undo any call you change your mind on.

items.name: reply-toolbar
items.title: Reply Toolbar
items.description: The quiet row under an AI reply where every small action gives something back: copy draws a check, regenerate opens a version switcher, a thumb asks what worked and read aloud turns into an equaliser.

items.name: request-access
items.title: Request Access
items.description: The page you hit when a doc is private: who you are signed in as, a switch-account menu, an optional note and a Request access button. It then shows who the request went to, when, and a resend that unlocks after a countdown.

items.name: request-builder
items.title: Request Builder
items.description: A small API playground: pick a method, type a URL whose :path params and query light up and turn into fields, toggle headers, check the JSON body as you type, then send for a status pill, timing, size and a pretty response.

items.name: revenue-overview
items.title: Revenue Story
items.description: A store's revenue told as a story: one big annotated line you can scrub day by day against last period, a plain-sentence summary whose numbers roll, a range switch that morphs the line and moves its notes, and a ranked strip of where the money came from.

items.name: review-feed
items.title: Review Feed
items.description: Every comment on a page in one list: filter by open or resolved, tick one off and watch it slide away, or type / to summarise them all or turn them into tasks.

items.name: rewind
items.title: Rewind
items.description: Scrub back through everything an agent changed on one timeline: later changes ghost out and show what they'd go back to, the ones that can't be undone pin the playhead with a lock and say why, and Rewind to here comes with an Undo.

items.name: rim-light
items.title: Rim Light
items.description: A point of light that laps a card's border at a steady pace with a fading tail, tracing rounded corners exactly; every beam on the page shares one clock, so busy cards pulse in step.

items.name: routing-rules
items.title: Routing Rules
items.description: Routing for a booking form: if company size is over 50 and the region is Europe, send it to Sales EU. Drag routes into order, see what share of last month each one caught, test a response to watch it land, and export the lot as one CASE WHEN.

items.name: rule-builder
items.title: Rule Builder
items.description: A nested query builder that reads like a sentence: Where, and, or, groups inside groups, drag or arrow-key rules into place, undo anything, and watch the parameterised SQL, JSON and plain English rewrite themselves as you type.

items.name: run-list
items.title: Run List
items.description: Keep an eye on every background agent from one calm list, with live clocks, counts by status and a click to see the last few steps or sign off the work.

items.name: run-replay
items.title: Run Replay
items.description: Watch an agent work a task from start to finish: plan steps tick off, tool calls stream into a log, it stops to ask before sending anything, and the draft it's writing fills in beside it.

items.name: sales-overview
items.title: Sales Overview
items.description: A year of sales on one page: pick a number up top and the monthly chart, best sellers and channel split all follow it, with a line or bar view to taste.

items.name: saved-views
items.title: Saved Views
items.description: Filters you keep as named views on a crisp tab bar: tweak one and a dot says it's unsaved, then save, discard or fork it. Every view travels as a share link with the filter in the URL hash, and links that no longer fit the schema are cleaned up instead of breaking.

items.name: scramble-text
items.title: Scramble Text
items.description: Text that decodes from random glyphs into the real words, sweeping left to right on view, on hover or on demand, with a monospace variant for codes and labels.

items.name: search-scan
items.title: Search Scan
items.description: Empty-state art for search: a magnifier reads down a page, zooming the lines under its lens, until it lands on the word you typed and highlights it.

items.name: security-settings
items.title: Security Settings
items.description: Password, two-factor, passkeys and sessions in grouped rows: a tiny ring counts recommended steps, passkeys are added inline while your device confirms, and signed-out sessions slide off the table one after another.

items.name: segment-builder
items.title: Segment Builder
items.description: Describe an audience in a few rules and watch it form: the head count rolls, the size bar slides, and real people from your sample glide in and out of the list as each rule tightens or loosens.

items.name: server-rack
items.title: Server Rack
items.description: A rack of humming units with blinking status lights – hover one and it slides forward, its bezel gliding off to show the drives inside.

items.name: settings-and-plans
items.title: Settings & Plans
items.description: Workspace, members, API keys and billing in one calm settings screen: grouped rows, an unsaved-changes bar that springs up, invites and role changes, keys shown once, and usage bars that fill when you open Billing.

items.name: shield-lock
items.title: Shield Lock
items.description: A glass shield that fills with liquid as it checks a passkey – the padlock flips colour as the tide rises past it and snaps shut, while a bad key turns the water red and drains it away.

items.name: shortcut-sheet
items.title: Shortcut Sheet
items.description: A keyboard cheat sheet that slides up when you press ? inside your app: searchable by action or key, grouped, with sequences and Mac or Windows keys.

items.name: sign-in
items.title: Sign In
items.description: A minimal centred sign-in: passkey and single sign-on side by side, email and password with a show toggle, a gentle shake when the password is wrong and a check when you’re in.

items.name: sign-in-card
items.title: Sign-in Card
items.description: Email and password sign-in with a peek toggle, a one-tap switch to magic links, passkey and SSO buttons, a gentle shake on errors and a calm check-your-inbox state.

items.name: sign-up
items.title: Sign Up
items.description: A minimal centred sign-up: name, work email and a password whose length hint ticks green as you type, with inline errors and the terms in one quiet line.

items.name: signature-pad
items.title: Signature Pad
items.description: A place to sign with a finger, mouse or pen: strokes come out smooth and swell with pressure or slow down, with undo, a typed fallback and a stamped, timestamped signed state.

items.name: since-you-left
items.title: Since You Left
items.description: What moved while you were away, one metric per row: a tiny trend line, the number now, and a change chip that knows when down is the good news.

items.name: skeleton-sweep
items.title: Skeleton Sweep
items.description: Loading placeholders lit by one sweep of light that crosses the whole card at once, with a matching glint for “Drafting…” status lines.

items.name: slash-menu
items.title: Slash Menu
items.description: A writing surface where typing / opens a command menu right at the caret, narrows as you type and drops in a styled block: heading, to-do, callout, code and more.

items.name: smart-search
items.title: Smart Search
items.description: One search box that speaks filter: type status:open owner:me priority>2 webhook and it becomes chips and a filtered table, with Tab to complete fields and values, minus to negate, ranges like priority:2..3, and typos flagged right on the chip.

items.name: social-pill
items.title: Social Pill
items.description: A like, comment, repost and share pill where each icon pops and fills with a tiny burst and every count rolls over digit by digit.

items.name: something-went-wrong
items.title: Something Went Wrong
items.description: An app error page with a small 1-bit dithered ?! glyph, Try again that fails once with a shake and then recovers into a check, a copyable error details panel and a quiet Report this link.

items.name: sparkline-table
items.title: Sparkline Table
items.description: A dense endpoint table where every row carries its own 24-hour sparkline, a delta that knows lower is better, and a status; sort any column and the rows glide into order.

items.name: spawn-tree
items.title: Spawn Tree
items.description: See which agent started which, with each one's time and cost ticking on its card and every branch adding up what it spent.

items.name: split-button
items.title: Split Button
items.description: A primary action with a menu of alternatives beside it: pick one and it runs, then takes the primary slot, its label springing to the new width.

items.name: split-card
items.title: Split Card
items.description: A total and what it's made of, in one small card: switch the period and the figures roll, the bar re-proportions and the ranked rows quietly trade places.

items.name: split-shell
items.title: Split Shell
items.description: A frame for working with an agent: tasks on the left, its thread in the middle, and a work panel you can drag or nudge with arrow keys to watch its tool calls tick by, the page it's reading and the sources it will cite.

items.name: split-sign-up
items.title: Split Sign-up
items.description: A two-panel sign-up: the form validates as you go (live email check, password rules that tick off, a strength bar) beside a product glimpse and rotating customer quotes that fold below on phones.

items.name: spotlight-text
items.title: Spotlight Text
items.description: Dimmed copy with a soft warm spotlight that trails your pointer, bringing the words underneath to full contrast and uncovering a line that isn't there otherwise; on touch, or once you leave, the light drifts on a slow path of its own.

items.name: stacked-explorer
items.title: Stacked Explorer
items.description: Twelve months of stacked bars you can re-cut by measure and by slice: segments settle at their new heights, hovering a month breaks it down, and the table below lights up the series under your pointer.

items.name: star-and-emoji-rating
items.title: Star & Emoji Rating
items.description: Two ways to ask how it went: stars with half steps that pop when you pick, and a little face that morphs from grumpy to delighted as you slide across the scale.

items.name: stats-band
items.title: Stats Band
items.description: A band of big figures that count up once when it scrolls into view, sitting on a hairline ruler that draws itself in, with labels and captions on a steady divider rhythm.

items.name: status-console
items.title: Status Console
items.description: An ops console where an incident plays out live: services with ticking p95 sparklines, a timeline that moves from investigating to resolved, the fix rolling out in recent deploys, and an on-call card you can page from the keyboard.

items.name: status-page
items.title: Status Page
items.description: A public status page: a banner that names what's wrong, 90 days of uptime bars you can scrub with mouse or arrow keys, an incident timeline, and an inline subscribe form.

items.name: status-pill
items.title: Status Pill
items.description: A tiny working indicator that rolls through what it's doing, from Reading to Searching to Writing, eases to fit each word and lands on a green check when it's finished.

items.name: step-flow
items.title: Step Flow
items.description: A three-step sign-up card where the progress bar pours into each step as you reach it, the card grows or shrinks to fit what's next and each field tells you what's missing as you go.

items.name: streak-heatmap
items.title: Streak Heatmap
items.description: A year of daily activity as a calendar heatmap: hover or arrow through any day, see which streak it belongs to, and point at a streak callout to light up its run.

items.name: streamed-reply
items.title: Streamed Reply
items.description: An answer that reads its sources first, then softly streams in word by word, with little numbered chips you can hover to peek at each source, all in a card that holds its size the whole time.

items.name: swarm
items.title: Swarm
items.description: A big job split across workers as a honeycomb: each cell fills with honey as its tasks finish, retries shimmer, failures crack, and done, failed, cost and time left roll along up top.

items.name: swatch-card
items.title: Swatch Card
items.description: A product card whose drawn bottle recolours as you hover the swatches and grows with the size you pick, with a price that rolls and an add button that turns into a stepper.

items.name: sync-pair
items.title: Sync Pair
items.description: A laptop and a phone toss a document back and forth along a soft arc; when both edit at once, the two versions meet mid-air and merge into one with a check.

items.name: tag-input
items.title: Tag Input
items.description: Type to add tags with grouped suggestions, paste a comma list to add a bunch at once, and backspace to pull the last one back for editing. Each group keeps its own colour.

items.name: tally-hero
items.title: Tally Hero
items.description: A hero led by one giant figure that rolls up digit by digit as the itemised statement beneath it prints line by line, landing on a total that matches, with a period switch that re-tallies both.

items.name: task-card
items.title: Task Card
items.description: A task card you can read at a glance: checklist progress, who's on it, and a due date that warms from grey to amber to red as it slips.

items.name: team-chat
items.title: Team Chat
items.description: Channels and DMs with grouped messages, reactions that roll their counts, and threads that open in a side panel; send something and a teammate starts typing back.

items.name: team-grid
items.title: Team Grid
items.description: Team cards with tinted initials portraits, roles and a ticking local clock; hover, focus or tap one and a short bio with links slides over, plus a team filter and a we're-hiring card.

items.name: team-roles
items.title: Members & Roles
items.description: Invite people, manage members and pending invites, and tune a role-by-permission matrix with a locked owner column, live head counts and a duplicate-to-customise role.

items.name: terminal
items.title: Terminal
items.description: A terminal that replays a session: commands typed at the prompt, output streamed in real ANSI colour, braille spinners that resolve to a tick, and a status bar that keeps time, with skip and replay.

items.name: theme-studio
items.title: Theme Studio
items.description: A live theme customiser: pick an accent hue, drag the corner radius, set the density, watch a sample card restyle as you go, then copy the CSS variables.

items.name: thread
items.title: Thread
items.description: A comment and its replies in one tidy card, where @mentions stand out and an assistant's reply opens up to show each step it took.

items.name: ticket-tear
items.title: Ticket Tear
items.description: A booking ticket that, once confirmed, rips along its perforation: the stub pulls open from the top, comes free and drops away with a lazy spin, and the ticket you keep slides back to centre with its torn edge intact.

items.name: time-wheel
items.title: Time Wheel
items.description: A drum-style time picker: flick the hours and minutes and they spin with momentum, curl away on a 3D wheel and snap onto the row, by touch, trackpad, mouse or keys.

items.name: toast-deck
items.title: Toast Deck
items.description: Notifications that settle into a tidy deck, fan open when you hover, swipe away to the side and turn from a spinner into a check when the work behind them finishes.

items.name: token-budget
items.title: Token Budget
items.description: See exactly what's filling your model's context, as a field of cells or a treemap of the same parts; hover anything to light it in both, drop a file you don't need, and Compact folds older turns into a short summary.

items.name: tool-receipt
items.title: Tool Receipt
items.description: Every tool call your agent makes prints as a little thermal receipt with its time, tokens and cost; tap one to unroll the arguments and result, failed calls get a red VOID stamp and a Retry, and a whole run stacks up on a spike with a running total.

items.name: torch-grid
items.title: Torch Grid
items.description: One soft light follows your pointer across a grid of cards, washing over the one you're on and catching the rims of its neighbours across the gaps.

items.name: triage-desk
items.title: Triage Desk
items.description: Work through agent output one card at a time, riskiest first, with the shaky parts marked and explained and a single key to approve, edit, reject or skip.

items.name: two-step-setup
items.title: Two-step Setup
items.description: Turn on authenticator-app 2FA in three calm steps: scan a coded QR or copy the setup key, type the six digits, then copy or download backup codes before you can finish.

items.name: typewriter
items.title: Typewriter
items.description: Types a phrase with a human rhythm, holds it long enough to read, then backspaces or selects it away and moves on; the caret only blinks while it waits.

items.name: typing-indicators
items.title: Typing Indicators
items.description: Four quiet ways to say a reply is coming: a dotted bubble, a named line, a stack of faces for busy threads and a soft shimmer for an assistant at work.

items.name: unplugged
items.title: Unplugged
items.description: Offline empty-state art: a loose plug sways beside its socket and sparks now and then, until Reconnect pushes it home with a click and the status light turns green.

items.name: upload-cloud
items.title: Upload Cloud
items.description: Empty-state art for uploads: a soft, breathing goo cloud reaches down, scoops up the file waiting below, fills a ring with a live percentage and lands on a tick.

items.name: upload-failed
items.title: Upload Failed
items.description: A batch upload where each failed file says exactly why, too large, wrong type or a dropped connection, next to the fix for it, and a retry picks up where the upload stopped.

items.name: upload-tray
items.title: Upload Tray
items.description: Drop files in and each one fans out into its own card with a coloured type badge, live progress and time left, while a failed upload waits patiently for a retry.

items.name: uptime-bars
items.title: Uptime Bars
items.description: A status-page block with 90 days of daily bars per service: hover or arrow along a row to read that day's uptime and incidents, with a headline that names whatever is broken right now.

items.name: verify-email
items.title: Verify Email
items.description: The 6-digit code step: a centred code field split 3 + 3, a shake when the code is wrong, a resend timer that counts down and a mail icon that turns into a check.

items.name: versus-table
items.title: Versus Table
items.description: An us-versus-the-old-way comparison with one raised, highlighted column, ticks that pop in as you scroll, a header that sticks, and a phone layout that compares against one rival at a time.

items.name: video-call
items.title: Video Call
items.description: A video call where the grid reflows as people drop in and out, whoever is talking gets a soft ring and a pulse, reactions float up the stage, and chat and people slide in beside it.

items.name: voice-note
items.title: Voice Note
items.description: A chat voice message you can scrub like a waveform, with a play button that morphs to pause, a speed chip that rolls, and a transcript that follows along word by word.

items.name: waitlist
items.title: Waitlist
items.description: A join-the-line card: your position rolls down digit by digit, a referral link to copy, and friends who sign up drop into slots while you jump toward the next wave.

items.name: webhook-inspector
items.title: Webhook Inspector
items.description: Incoming webhook deliveries with status and latency at a glance, a detail pane for payload, headers and your endpoint’s response, and Redeliver that slides a new attempt into the list and lets you watch it land.

items.name: webhook-relay
items.title: Webhook Relay
items.description: Signed event packets fan out from a relay to three endpoints; one fails, bounces back and retries with a growing backoff until it lands. Hover a node to pause and read it.

items.name: week-agenda
items.title: Week Agenda
items.description: Your week on one strip and your day on a timeline, where you can drag a meeting to a new time and see straight away if it clashes with another.

items.name: wordmark-ticker
items.title: Wordmark Ticker
items.description: A quiet strip of customer wordmarks that eases to a stop under your cursor, flings when you drag it, and pauses with a click.

items.name: working-out-loud
items.title: Working Out Loud
items.description: Lets people watch an agent think: a running clock, steps that tick off along a rail, sources that slide in as they're found, and a tidy one-line summary once it's done.
